map.查询尿沉渣中管型、结晶、细胞等有形成分的形态与临床意义: Look up the morphology and clinical significance of formed elements in urine sediment: casts, crystals and cells.
map.对尿沉渣有形成分（红细胞/白细胞/管型/结晶）的形态与提示做图谱式对照，辅助镜检: Provides an atlas-style comparison of the morphology and cues of urine-sediment formed elements (RBC/WBC/casts/crystals) to aid microscopy review.
map.取新鲜尿10mL离心(1500rpm/5min)，留0.2mL沉渣镜检。管型在低: Take 10 mL fresh urine, centrifuge (1500 rpm/5 min), keep 0.2 mL sediment for microscopy. Count casts under low power (x10) across 20 fields; count cells under high power (x40) across 10 fields. Casts are based on hyaline matrix; those containing cells/granules differ in meaning.
map.沉渣镜检复习红细胞（均一/变形）与白细胞鉴别。: Review RBC (uniform/dysmorphic) and WBC differentiation under sediment microscopy.
map.管型类型（透明/颗粒/细胞/蜡样）对应肾实质提示。: Cast types (hyaline/granular/cellular/waxy) correspond to renal-parenchyma cues.
map.教学演示结晶（草酸钙/尿酸）形态差异。: Demonstrate crystal morphology differences (calcium oxalate/uric acid).
map.多形性/变形红细胞为主提示肾小球性血尿可能；均一红细胞更倾向非肾小球来源，工具并: Predominantly polymorphic/dysmorphic RBC suggests glomerular hematuria; uniform RBC tends toward non-glomerular origin. The tool lists key points side by side to aid judgment.
map.看到管型就有肾病？: Does seeing casts mean kidney disease?
map.少量透明管型可生理出现；颗粒/细胞/蜡样管型多提示肾实质病变，需结合临床。: A few hyaline casts can appear physiologically; granular/cellular/waxy casts mostly suggest renal parenchymal lesions and need clinical correlation.
map.草酸钙等可生理出现，尿酸/胱氨酸结晶与代谢相关；持续大量需评估。: Calcium oxalate etc. can appear physiologically; uric acid/cystine crystals relate to metabolism; persistent large amounts need evaluation.
map.能替代镜检报告吗: Can it replace the microscopy report?
map.不能，本工具为形态复习，结果以检验师镜检为准。: No; this tool is for morphology review, and the result should follow the laboratorian's microscopy.
map.尿沉渣有形成分图谱工具。对照红细胞/白细胞/管型/结晶形态与提示，辅助镜检复习；: A urine-sediment formed-element atlas. Compares RBC/WBC/cast/crystal morphology and cues to aid microscopy review; interpretation is confirmed by the laboratorian.
